data.title: Israel, US tried to appoint Mahmoud Ahmadinejad as Iran's new leader | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: An associate of Ahmadinejad told the NYT that the Americans viewed Mr. Ahmadinejad as someone who could lead Iran and manage “Iran’s political, social, and military situation.”
